claims.claim: Micron reported fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $41.456B, GAAP gross margin of 84.6%, operating cash flow of $25.39B and adjusted free cash flow of $18.3B, materially strengthening source-addressed evidence for current operating momentum.

Micron's fiscal Q3 2026 Cloud Memory revenue was $13.769B with 83% gross margin and Core Data Center revenue was $11.524B with 87% gross margin, providing segment-level evidence that current economics are strongly exposed to data-center/AI memory demand rather than only roadmap narrative.
Micron guided fiscal Q4 2026 revenue to $50.0B plus or minus $1.0B and gross margin to approximately 86%, creating a precise near-term execution benchmark for the September 30 results event.

Micron disclosed $7.1B of fiscal Q3 net capital expenditures while ending the quarter with $30.2B of cash, marketable investments and restricted cash, directly documenting both capital intensity and near-term balance-sheet capacity.

factors.name: financialOperatingMomentum
factors.basis: Primary fiscal Q3 results show large sequential revenue, gross-margin, operating-cash-flow and free-cash-flow expansion.

factors.name: thesisQuality
factors.basis: Data-center-facing business-unit revenue and margins provide operating evidence consistent with the existing AI-memory bottleneck thesis.

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: The company supplied an explicit Q4 revenue/gross-margin benchmark that can be tested at the September 30 earnings event; the event outcome remains unknown.

factors.name: capitalIntensity
factors.basis: $7.1B quarterly net capex is substantial, while $18.3B adjusted free cash flow and $30.2B cash/investments provide current funding capacity.

risks.risk: The unusually high current margins and growth can increase normalization risk; this evidence documents current performance but does not establish durability through a full memory cycle.
The Q4 outlook is management guidance, not realized performance; September 30 results are the falsification checkpoint.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not establish marketValuationOpportunity because this evidence set contains no canonical security-level valuation input.
GovernancePower, alignment2036, crossDivisionLeverage and pricingPower still require root-owner interpretation and/or additional source-addressed evidence under Methodology 1.0.

claims.claim: Fiscal Q3 actual revenue of $41.456B exceeded the prior $33.5B plus-or-minus $0.75B Q3 outlook shown in Micron's quarterly-results history, while Q3 GAAP gross margin reached 84.6% versus the prior approximately 81% outlook; this is evidence of positive execution versus the company's own earlier benchmark.

The next execution test is unusually explicit: Q4 revenue guidance is $50.0B plus or minus $1.0B and gross margin approximately 86%, so September 30 results can be evaluated against a pre-existing numeric benchmark without rewriting expectations after the fact.

factors.name: Execution versus prior expectations
factors.basis: Q3 reported revenue and gross margin exceeded Micron's earlier Q3 outlook ranges.

factors.name: Forward expectation burden
factors.basis: Q4 guidance embeds another sequential step-up; strong current performance raises the benchmark that future execution must clear.

risks.risk: Beating a prior quarterly guide does not by itself prove long-duration pricing power or cycle resilience.

unknowns.unknown: Fiscal Q4 2026 results are not yet reported as of this evidence timestamp and must not be inferred.
